mapper.select: select codebid, codeaid, "name" as codebname from codeb where codeaid=#{codeAId}
mapper.insert: insert into codeb (codebid, codeaid, name) values(#{codeBId}, #{codeAId}, #{codeBName})
mapper.select: select a.codeaid, b.codebid, a.name as codeaname, b.name as codebname from codea a join codeb b on a.codeaid = b.codeaid where a.codeaid = 'SCHEDULE_TYPE' order by b.codebid
